items.title: Apple Launches New App to Study AI's Role in Health
items.summary: Apple has introduced a new application designed to research how individuals utilize AI technologies for managing and improving their health, marking a significant step into AI-driven health data collection.

items.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.summary: A new paper explores the future of robotics, highlighting the emergence of agentic robotic systems that promise a transformative impact across various industries.

items.title: Indian Chip Startup Bharat Semi Secures $24M Seed Round for Global AI Sensor Market
items.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has successfully raised a $24 million seed round, aiming to expand its presence in the global market for AI-powered sensors.

items.title: Is Bad News for Jensen Huang Also Bad News for the AI Industry?
items.summary: An analysis questions whether potential setbacks for NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang could signal broader challenges for the entire artificial intelligence industry.

items.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agents
items.summary: Researchers introduce 'Gamer,' a new foundation model capable of understanding vision, language, and actions to create generalist AI agents for complex, long-horizon tasks in real-time gaming environments.

items.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.summary: A new foundation model demonstrates emergent capabilities in understanding molecular interactions, hinting at significant advancements for AI applications in biology and drug discovery.

items.title: OpenAI Explores Foundational Physics with New Research on Standard Model on a Lattice
items.summary: OpenAI has published new research detailing a step toward defining the Standard Model of particle physics on a lattice, indicating a deeper dive into scientific computing with AI.

items.title: How Amplitude Ships Product Improvements in 1–2 Days with OpenAI
items.summary: Amplitude shares insights into how they leverage OpenAI's technologies to rapidly iterate and deploy product improvements, significantly accelerating their development cycle.

items.title: Does the Ranking Hold? Auditing Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
items.summary: A practitioner-focused audit investigates the effectiveness of hallucination detectors when applied to small, quantized, and on-device large language models, crucial for real-world deployment.

items.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
items.summary: New research addresses the critical challenge of memory management in LLM agents, proposing strategies for memory filtering to mitigate errors in query resolution.

items.title: Agent-R^2: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
items.summary: This research introduces Agent-R^2, a method for scaling AI agents to perform realistic productivity tasks by synthesizing data from real-world sources, enhancing their practical applicability.

items.title: MEM-SQL: Memory-Empowered Text-to-SQL
items.summary: A new approach called MEM-SQL enhances text-to-SQL capabilities by integrating memory mechanisms, allowing for more robust and context-aware database querying through natural language.

items.title: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
items.summary: HALO presents a novel framework for collecting human-aligned data specifically designed for whole-body mobile manipulation, crucial for developing more intuitive and capable robotic systems.

items.title: MCP, A2A, UCP, AP2... Confused? A Simple Map of AI Agent Protocols (November 2026)
items.summary: A helpful guide provides a clear overview and map of the increasingly complex landscape of AI agent protocols, simplifying understanding for developers and practitioners.

items.title: One Model Gateway Across Clouds: LiteLLM on Cloud Run and Azure with Zero API Keys
items.summary: A practical guide demonstrates how to deploy LiteLLM as a unified model gateway across Google Cloud Run and Azure, enabling secure, API key-less access to various AI models.
